excerpts.content:
Doing some polishes in Geth's VM code. I kind of realized that there's an opcode assymetry:

We have BASEFEE and GASPRICE
But we only have BLOBBASEFEE and have no BLOBGASPRICE

Would it make sense to add the latter to make thing symemtric and expose the blob fee cap to the EVM too?

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: or call it BLOBFEECAP for all it matters

excerpts.author: yperbasis
excerpts.content: There's no priority fee for blob gas, so no distinction between blob base fee and effective fee.

excerpts.author: karalabe
excerpts.content: Ah yeah. no way to retrieve the gasfeecap either, ok
